text: Ko Alla woni nuloowo immina keneeli ɗin, ɗi sogga duule ɗen; O saakitira ɗum ka weeyo no O muuyiri, ɗuuɗi fanɗi; O waɗta ɗum taƴe-taƴe. A yi'ay ontuma, an ndaaroowo on, toɓo ngon no yalta hakkunde mun. Si O hewtinii toɓo ngon e on Mo O muuyi e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, e jaka hiɓe weltora yurmeende Alla nden e maɓɓe, woni heɓugol toɓo, leydi ndin fuɗina ko ɓe haajitora kamɓe e neemoraaɗi maɓɓe.
